title: Anti-vaccine group once led by RFK Jr back on Facebook and Instagram after being banned
summary_full: Children’s Health Defense was removed from Facebook and Instagram in 2022. Meta declined to comment on why it allowed the group backAn anti-vaccine group led for years by Robert F Kennedy Jr has been allowed back on Facebook and Instagram, four years after Meta removed the group for repeatedly violating its misinformation policies.A review by the Guardian found that Children’s Health Defense (CHD) has reopened or opened six accounts on Facebook and Instagram from May through September this year. The group is using its accounts to share false and misleading information about topics including vaccines and deadly measles outbreaks at a time when measles has come roaring back. Health officials have reported 10 measles-associated deaths in the United States this year, and the country this week lost its measles elimination status in an official recognition that it is again endemic in the US after being eliminated for 26 years.
